title: Final Probability (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the probability P1 for the particle in the ground state of the expanded box as 32/(9π^2).

title: Final Probability (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine that the first excited state has a probability P2 of 1/2.

title: Final Distribution (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the momentum probability distribution correctly as 2πħ^3L/((ħ^2π^2 - p^2L^2)^2)(1 + cos(pL/ħ)).

title: Wave Function Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the initial and final wave functions for the particle in the box.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration steps for calculating probabilities from the wave functions.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a check for the normalization of the wave functions used in the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the integration process.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
